name: Appliance repair & warranty (category guide)
summary: Washer / fridge / oven call-outs — landlord vs tenant responsibility, authorised service centres, and WhatsApp repair bait-and-switch quotes.
body: Condo appliance failures land in tenancy grey zones: many TAs put fair wear on the landlord and misuse on the tenant — photograph the fault and read the inventory before calling a random repair chat. Authorised brand service centres protect warranty; grey-market parts can void it. 24-hour WhatsApp ‘fix anything’ outfits are a classic bait-and-switch — demand a written call-out fee and diagnosis fee before they open the machine. For landlord-owned appliances, get written approval before paying cash you hope to reclaim from deposit. Distinct from handyman general trades and from end-of-lease cleaning. Category guide, not a ranked repair-shop list.
